listing.name: More Tolerant Luddic Majority
listing.summary: Simply makes the Luddic Majority market condition tolerate Mining, Military Base and High Command industries.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the Luddic Majority market condition to tolerate Mining, Military Base, and High Command.

description:
More Tolerant Luddic Majority

Tired of your Luddic Majority populations disliking being protected or having industries that predate the written word? Well here's the solution!

This mod simply changes the Luddic Majority market condition to tolerate:

Mining, Military Base, High Command

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZfimEu0q7ykOaCOInzATWWH0sIT6roIk/view?usp=drive_link

aiDescription: This mod adjusts the Luddic Majority market condition to allow tolerance for Mining, Military Base, and High Command industries. It addresses player frustration with the base game's restrictions on these specific industry types within Luddic Majority systems.
